A real look inside

Three very different reasons to leave the house.

The guide is not a giant generic directory. These are three of the actual adventures inside it, with the practical details and current information links alongside them in the full guide.

Heritage · indoor

Go under Stockport

Explore the wartime air-raid shelters beneath the town centre. A strong rainy-day option that feels considerably stranger than another lap of the shops.

Canals · engineering

Find Marple Aqueduct

Walk the lock flight, then find the canal carried high above the River Goyt beside the railway viaduct.

Big walk · short trip

Climb Mam Tor

A proper ridge walk for the day you want something bigger than a local lap, with the route and practical caveats kept together.

What sort of adventures?

Why SK8 Scoop made it

Because choosing what to do can take longer than doing it.

Local ideas are scattered across venue websites, old lists and search results that rarely tell you the awkward bits. 52 Adventures pulls the useful parts together: what sort of outing it is, what it costs, restrictions that matter, current caveats and the official information to check before you set off.
